notes.title: Number Machine is Comming Soon!
notes.content:
[p]Hello!

I'm happy to announce that a second game is currently in development with visuals and animations just as stylish as in Please Fix The Road!
 [/p][previewyoutube="yFtb9qv3haA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Wishlist it today so you don’t miss the demo![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231090/Number_Machine/"][/dynamiclink]
This time, I’m creating a puzzly factory automation game with numbers and math mechanics. Take constantly spawning orbs with numbers, move them around using conveyors, pushers, turntables, rotators, and more. Connect them into complex structures, transform them using the power of math, and deliver the required shape to win. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.
[/p][p]Once again, thank you very much,
- Ariel
[/p]

notes.title: Coming to SWITCH, PLAYSTATION & XBOX this May!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053216/a42e23e072c6c866673f84b2ce1b0b90f0deba1e.png[/img]

[h2]Hello Consoles[/h2]

I'm happy to announce that Please Fix The Road will be arriving on consoles on [u]May 15th and 16th, 2024[/u]! Yes, in just about two weeks! 

The game will be available on both current and last generation consoles.

After nearly two years since its initial release, it's finally time to welcome all console players to join the existing 25.000 PC players to fix some roads.

Thank you very much, cheers!

notes.title: macOS Support & 1.2 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053216/eea647a4a446cd8ec180784e08610e1ea381d41c.png[/img]

[h1]macOS[/h1]

Please Fix The Road was originally released for Windows and Linux and was quickly Steam Deck Verified (some say that our Lord Gabe Newell himself verified my game, but that's just a theory). Today, I am completing the platform collection and adding macOS support (both old Intel and new Apple silicon).


[h1]Update 1.2[/h1]

I am currently working to deliver you the Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation ports of the game. I really wanted to fix all of the bugs I've discovered for these versions and bring these changes to PC as well. The game should perform even better.
[list]

[*] Updated the Unity engine to the latest LTS version
[*] Performance improvements for water, physics, and UI (you can thank the Switch port)
[*] Faster closing of the game
[*] New particles and developer logo in the intro sequence
[*] Bugfix: Sometimes, the bottom UI doesn't show up mid-tutorial
[*] Bugfix: Rare crashes on less powerful machines or during heavy lag
[*] Bugfix: Rare animation bugs on less powerful machines or during heavy lag
[*] Bugfix: It was possible to bug out the undo/redo feature with specific actions
[*] Bugfix: Missing script errors in the log file
[*] Bugfix: During very long play sessions, some level switch animations glitched a bit
[*] Bugfix: Tile icons at the bottom UI are sometimes off-center
[/list]

[h1]Arrghh![/h1]

On the game launch date, I released a special unlicensed version of the game on torrents as a sign of good faith to my "unpaid clients". From now on, you can enable this mode by adding a super-secret "pirate" command-line argument ːsteamhappyː


[h1]Future[/h1]

If you enjoyed Please Fix The Road perhaps you could [url=https://arielek.com/discord]kindly join my Discord server[/url] as well? I'm currently working on my next title, and it's the best place to get more information about it sometime next year. Alternatively, you can join [url=https://arielek.com]my mailing list that you can find it ony my website[/url] and I'll send you a lovely e-mail with chocolate and kisses... if you prefer that. Be patient, let me cook ːpftr_loveː

notes.title: Please Fix The Road Trading Cards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053216/5199ebe3933d6fda1defd23e3cd48a4e01cc70c7.png[/img]

Hello!

Today I've surpassed 10.000 copies sold, which I thought would be an unachievable milestone. Big thanks for deciding to buy the game!

Thanks to your purchases, Steam unlocked the ability to release Trading Cards for Please Fix The Road. For sure, it's a very cool addition to the game. As you can see, they are as colorful as the game itself.

You are able to collect a set of five cards, each represents one of the color themes from the game, and they include all the pathway types (road, water, rail and dirt).

Thank you once again, and I hope you enjoy them. Cheers!

notes.title: I can't stop solving these clever little road puzzles because the payoff is so darn good
notes.content: What typically happens in a puzzle game when you solve a puzzle? You're presented with another puzzle to solve. But you just used your brain and clicked your mouse and did all that hard work—I think you should get a little reward beyond the game saying, "Okay, genius, do another one.".. Read more.

notes.content:
[list]
    [*]10 new easy levels for beginner players that explain the game mechanics better. Trivial for puzzle enjoyers, but very needed for casual players. Now there are 160 levels in total.
	[*]Simplified a few starting levels based on observations of how players play them on Twitch and YouTube. Don't worry, hard puzzles remain untouched.
	[*]Changed the level order a lot, there are more easier levels first and the harder one got pushed to the later stage of the game. This doesn't change the overall difficulty of them game, just eases the player into it better. Levels from 1 to 60 should be more approachable now.
    [*]Fixed minor visual error in one of the level switch animation
	[*]Removed decorations on a few levels that obstructed the view too much
	[*]Fixed bug, where the game wouldn't switch to skipped levels after finishing the last level 
	[*]Fixed bug, where the interface would hide too late in the level switch animation
[/list]

[u]Please consider leaving a review for the game on Steam, either negative or positive. This help with the game discoverability. Cheers![/u]

notes.title: Please Fix The Road will have an official version just for pirates
notes.content:
Please Fix The Road is an upcoming puzzle game I highlighted back in March because it looks simply beautiful and perhaps a bit of a challenge. The developer announced recently a rather unusual plan in the indie dev space, involving pirates.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/05/please-fix-the-road-will-have-an-official-version-just-for-pirates

notes.title: Indie dev is releasing an official pirate version of his upcoming game, 'no strings attached'
notes.content: Please Fix the Road is a lovely, laid back-looking puzzle game about—in case the title wasn't enough of a giveaway—fixing roads. The goal is to move and manipulate tiles of various sorts to ensure that cars, boats, trains, and even animals can get from where they are to where they need to be. It's set to come out in June, and will be available on Steam, GOG, Itch.io, and various pirate torrents... Read more.

notes.title: Pirates added to pirate-less indie game as a treat for pirates
notes.content:
The solo developer behind Please Fix the Road, a colourful puzzle game in which you try and rearrange tiles to repair and reconnect decrepit roads, is nearing release on PC. Ahead of launch, developer Ariel Jurkowski announced that Please Fix the Road will launch on Steam, GOG... and on torrent sites.

This is not a mistake, Jurkowski is intentionally creating a "pirated" version of their own game, which will be going live on popular torrent sites alongside official stores.

While this isn't the first time we've seen a version of this tactic, Jurkowski isn't actually trying to make an inferior version of the game for pirates, or even guilt trip them into buying it. Instead, as the developer explained on Twitter, this torrent version of Please Fix the Road will include all of the content available to Steam and GOG owners.

Read more
